title: Evidence-graded molecular benchmarks for colorectal cancer-on-a-chip: code, frozen panels and protocols (v1.3)
description: Code, frozen gene panels (with SHA-256 hashes), dated analysis protocols and metadata for the study 'Evidence-Graded Molecular Benchmarks for Colorectal Cancer-on-a-Chip Models Derived from Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics' (Bioinformatics Advances, submitted 2026). Compact transcript panels for eight programs in five tumor-microenvironment compartments were selected in a discovery single-cell cohort, frozen, and evaluated in three independent single-cell cohorts and three spatial cohorts. All input data are public and are not redistributed.
